metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La2 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La3 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La4 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La5 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La6 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La7 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La8 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La9 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La10 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La11 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La12 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La13 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La14 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La15 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La16 (La) has 8 O neighbors; La17 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La18 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La19 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La20 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La21 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La1B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La2B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La3B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La4B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La5B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La6B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La7B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La8B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La9B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La10B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La11B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La12B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La13B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La14B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La15B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La16B (La) has 8 O neighbors; La17B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La18B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La19B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La20B (La) has 9 O neighbors; La21B (La) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 70 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.637-4.057 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.93-113.09°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C280H378La42O238. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 28 OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 84 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
